visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman in a beige sweater and grey pants winking and gesturing playfully towards the camera. She stands in a brightly lit indoor room with a light wood grain wardrobe in the background. (2) A close-up shot features a hand demonstrating a pink and green gyroscopic "no-spill" bowl filled with brown stick-shaped snacks, rotating it to show the mechanism against a cabinet background. (3) A toddler girl in a white sweatshirt with a crown graphic sits in a white high chair; she holds the bowl and flips it over, causing snacks to scatter across the wooden floor. She looks surprised and points down. (4) The woman returns to the scene holding a sleek blue and grey floor cleaner, striking a pose and dancing with the device in front of the wardrobe. (5) Close-up shots highlight the product's design, focusing on the "Huei Yeh" and "i-Cyndi" branding on the handle and the cleaning head. (6) The floor cleaner is demonstrated on the spilled snacks and milk; it effortlessly sucks up the mess in a single pass on the wood-textured floor. (7) A detail shot shows the removal of a waste tray, revealing separated solids and liquid waste inside the machine. (8) The woman is shown filling a black water tank at a kitchen sink under a running tap. (9) A domestic cat sits on a brown suitcase, calmly watching the woman use the cleaner nearby to illustrate its low noise level. (10) To show portability, the woman lifts the cleaner like a barbell; then she demonstrates the machine's ability to lie flat while cleaning under a bed frame. (11) The video concludes with the woman smiling broadly while holding a large blue product box with white lettering.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic female greeting over a fast-tempo, upbeat pop track with a strong electronic beat. (2) As the bowl is spinning, a light plastic rattling sound effect is layered with the upbeat BGM. (3) A distinct 'uh-oh' sound effect triggers a transition as the toddler spills the snacks. (4) The sound of snacks clattering on the floor is accompanied by a canned laughter sound effect. (5) A chime SFX introduces the floor cleaner; the female narrator switches to a more persuasive, enthusiastic commercial tone. (6) A consistent low-frequency mechanical hum and suction sound are heard as the device operates. (7) A celebratory 'Woo' vocal effect plays when the mess is cleaned. (8) High-frequency splashing sounds are prominent as the water tank is filled at the sink. (9) The narrator's voice becomes significantly quieter and breathy, whispering about the low noise levels over a faint mechanical whir. (10) The volume returns to high arousal for the final product call-to-action and closing brand jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Feature Breakdown -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional product comparison and showcase. It first hooks the viewer with a failed 'life hack' (the no-spill bowl) used by a toddler to create a mess, and then introduces the 'i-Cyndi' floor cleaner as the ultimate solution for mothers. It highlights the device's suction power, waste separation, quietness, and portability through a series of practical demonstrations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, branding overlays, verbal endorsement of features, and showing the final product box.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality short-form social media production with dense information layering, synchronized SFX, and clear commercial intent.
